inputs.xtext_rule_text:
Dependency returns SysML::Dependency :
	( ownedRelationship += PrefixMetadataAnnotation )*
	'dependency' ( Identification? 'from' )?
    client += [SysML::Element|QualifiedName] ( ',' client += [SysML::Element|QualifiedName] )* 'to'
    supplier += [SysML::Element|QualifiedName] ( ',' supplier += [SysML::Element|QualifiedName] )*
    RelationshipBody
;

decision: SysML 8.2.2.3 states Dependency = ( ownedRelationship += PrefixMetadataAnnotation )* 'dependency' DependencyDeclaration RelationshipBody, and the SysML Xtext agrees (the same prefix, keyword and body, with DependencyDeclaration's body inlined; the inlining is not ported). The rule is the clause as written.
